decisions.decision: Run the scan inside --verify-run, after the checks are recorded
decisions.why: implement already calls it before closing, so the hits sit with the run evidence and no new hook is needed
decisions.rejected: a separate script beside write-context.py that implement would have to remember to call

decisions.decision: Scan the uncommitted change plus new files against HEAD, through a scratch index
decisions.why: implement commits only after it records its checks, and the scratch index leaves the user staging untouched
decisions.rejected: diffing against the merge base, which would re-report earlier commits on the branch

decisions.decision: A later scan replaces the earlier scan concerns
decisions.why: a cut the agent fixed before closing should not stay on the Overview
decisions.rejected: append-only, which would keep fixed cuts forever

concerns.note: Arrow-function no-ops such as () => {} are not counted as empty stubs, to keep test callbacks from flooding the Overview
